missions.title: Petrichor
missions.description: The "Interim Regulations for Doll Security" established to deal with the Doll crisis has brought a unexpected chaos to Frankfurt.

missions.title: Mapping Time
missions.description: Waking up from a dream that was seemingly without end, the Commander saw the person they have long been waiting to see.

missions.title: Dark River
missions.description: Moving past the crowd of protestors, Nele went to visit her cousin. But behind the their joyful, nostalgic chatter, a dark river flowed.

missions.title: Lines Outlining Shadows
missions.description: With Nele's help, AR-18's group was finally allowed into Frankfurt.

missions.title: Light as a Feather I
missions.description: Change, growth and rebirth. What a caterpillar calls the end of the world is called a butterfly by the knowledgeable.

missions.title: Trek
missions.description: Griffin's Dolls have met up successfully. Operation "Adrasteia" begins.

missions.title: Double Exposure
missions.description: A woman operating in the name of "Miss Hebe" has appeared in Paradeus' base. A new plot is brewing...

missions.title: Light as a Feather II
missions.description: Nytos obviously experience jealousy, rivalry, and can be defensive, vicious and cruel... Why can't they be classified as human then?

missions.title: Lost in Chaos
missions.description: After the short meeting with Miss Hebe, Nele begins on her journey to the White Zones to see her maternal grandfather. A mysterious expedition awaits.

missions.title: A Beautiful Loneliness
missions.description: While the world is in chaos, two prisoners have a date, isolated from the world.

missions.title: The Fog Rises
missions.description: Squad 404 moves out, hacking into the Bee Sting system to find information. The squad appearing to be as normal has a dark, vicious malevolence hanging above their heads.

missions.title: Light as a Feather III
missions.description: Let us once again meet in the cocoon, and be reborn in it.

missions.title: The Gaze
missions.description: After an unpleasant meeting with her maternal grandfather in the White Zones, Nele reunites with an unexpected person from her past.

missions.title: Fade to Black
missions.description: Squad 404 has not realized that danger has fixed its gaze on them.

missions.title: Light as a Feather IV
missions.description: Every Nyto from the "Cocoon" has their own hopes and desires.

missions.title: Our War
missions.description: If Chekhov's gun appears in the very first scene, then it must be fired in the third.

missions.title: Nowhere to Hide
missions.description: While recording all available intelligence regarding the White Zones, Nele finally meets whom she wishes to, but in an unexpected manner.

missions.title: Light as a Feather V
missions.description: One butterfly emerges from three cocoons strung together.

missions.title: A Cowering Portrait
missions.description: Like an icicle falling from a glacier, she plunges toward an endless darkness.

missions.title: Rupture
missions.description: The end of one campaign heralds the start of another.
